highlights: ideal investment or first time purchase
summary: A well-presented ground floor one-bedroom apartment in the heart of Eastbourne offering comfortable and practical living accommodation. The property comprises a bright living area, fitted kitchen, double bedroom and modern bathroom.
description: A well presented ground floor apartment comprising a lounge to the front with a double glazed window, and a kitchen to the rear fitted with wall and base units, an electric oven with gas hob, and space for a washing machine. The property benefits from one spacious double bedroom with ample room for furniture, and a bathroom featuring a bath with glass shower panel, WC, and sink. This apartment offers practical, comfortable living and is ideally suited for first-time buyers or investors, conveniently located close to local amenities and transport links.
